requirements.title: The /graph page shall provide a visible search input above the graph canvas

vision.paraphrase: Search is a core MVP feature supporting live semantic re-ranking via a client-side input.

conops.paraphrase: A visitor notices the search input above the graph canvas.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall embed a visitor's typed query client-side and compute cosine similarity against each page's precomputed embedding from vector-index.json

vision.paraphrase: Real semantic search requires typed queries to rank pages by cosine similarity over build-time-precomputed embeddings.
Build-time embeddings per page enable client-side cosine-similarity ranking as the user types.

conops.paraphrase: The client-side JS embeds the typed query and computes cosine similarity against precomputed per-page embeddings.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall re-rank and visually highlight graph nodes by similarity score in real time as the visitor types, without a page reload or backend call

vision.paraphrase: Search provides live-filtering the graph with real-time re-ranking based on cosine-similarity scores.

conops.paraphrase: Nodes are re-ranked/highlighted by similarity score in real time as the visitor types.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall dim or fade nodes below a relevance threshold out of the active view when a search query is active

conops.paraphrase: Nodes below the relevance threshold dim or fade out of view to highlight the most relevant results.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall surface a page as a top-ranked search result when the query is conceptually related to that page's content even if the query's exact words do not appear in the page text

vision.paraphrase: The tool must provide genuine semantic search, not a keyword filter that deceives users into thinking AI-powered search is real.
Real semantic search must rank by conceptual similarity, not keyword presence.

conops.paraphrase: The visitor can confirm that a page surfaces even when it never contains the literal query words, proving semantic rather than keyword matching.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall restore the full unfiltered graph view when the visitor clears the search input

vision.paraphrase: Search is described as 'client-side cosine-similarity ranking as the user types' — a live binding to input state implies clearing the input is the natural inverse operation that restores the unfiltered graph.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall display a no-results indication when a query's highest similarity score falls below the relevance threshold for every page

vision.paraphrase: The 'real semantic search' goal implies honest feedback when nothing meets the relevance bar, rather than silently showing a misleading full or empty graph — this is the negative-path counterpart to the ranking requirement.
